'''Frotto''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], he managed a small shop, also teaching the knowledge of [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]] construction to others.
